shared_elements: anthropomorphic/composite figure carved in relief filling the whole field
dense ornamental detailing (scrolls, beads, scale-like textures)
frontal or profile face with prominent eye
band of small repeated signs along an edge (glyph-like row / border inscription)
elaborate headdress-like crest above the head
justification: Both surfaces show a single dominant figure in high relief whose body is covered in dense ornamental detail, with a row of small repeated glyph-like signs along one edge and an elaborate crest/headdress over the head. But A depicts a frontal standing human with symmetrical regalia and staff-like held objects on a tall narrow shaft, while B depicts a profile bird-headed winged composite creature striding with outspread feathered wings in a wide rectangular panel; the postures, viewpoints and creature types are entirely unrelated.
